card_text: The textured crop from Hobbs: styled with your fingers every day, cut in Carlsbad every 70 miles.

seo.title: Textured Crop for Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Textured crop and French crop for Hobbs, cut in Carlsbad about 80 minutes west. A short forward top that styles in seconds and lasts between trips.

paragraphs: A short top cut into pieces on purpose and pushed forward into a stubby fringe over tight sides. I cut the textured crop in Carlsbad; Hobbs is {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles east of my chair, a drive of about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes on {{city:hobbs.route}} (OpenStreetMap routing).
It's the cut I'd point to when someone wants short hair that still looks like a haircut, and doesn't want to think about it between drives.

blocks.heading: I style it once. Your fingers do the rest.
paragraphs: The only day a barber styles a crop is the day you drive the {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes home. Every morning after that it's a push forward with your hand, done. That's the appeal: a cut that looks intentional with nobody keeping it that way.

To stretch the time between trips, ask me to leave the fringe a touch shorter than the photos. It grows into the usual length over the following weeks instead of past it, and the shape holds until the fringe lands on your eyebrows.

blocks.heading: A little puff reads as texture.
paragraphs: Hobbs averages about {{city:hobbs.humidity_pct}} relative humidity, compared with {{city:carlsbad.humidity_pct}} in Carlsbad (Open-Meteo, 2023–25). Thick hair can swell a little on damp mornings. On a sleek style that looks like frizz; on a crop, where the pieces are already cut to separate, it just looks like more texture.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: A precision cut: top broken up, fringe set, sides tapered or faded, neckline cleaned with the straight razor, then pushed forward so you see it done right.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Same crop, beard included, hot towel at the end.

items.q: Textured crop or French crop if I'm driving from Hobbs?
items.a: The French crop has a blunt, even fringe, which shows unevenness as it grows. The textured version is cut uneven to begin with, so it forgives the weeks between trips better.

items.q: How short should the fringe be for a longer gap between visits?
items.a: A bit above where you'd normally wear it. Tell me how many weeks you want it to last and I'll cut to that.
The textured crop page shows a fuller back view and a shorter side view.
